description: Aggregate Fisher tests by nucleotide-site subregion, Hsp110 versus Hsp70 orthologs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
R=pd.read_csv("hsp110_vs_hsp70_position_test.csv")
# Three functional subsets defined from the 1KAX contact census (computed earlier), not from the result
KSHELL=["D10","Y15","Y149","D199","T204","D206"]      # the six protein ligands of the catalytic K+ in 1KAX
PHOS  =["T13","T14","G202","G203","T37","K56"]        # beta/gamma-phosphate contacts and phosphate-region residues
ADEN  =["G230","E268","K271","R272","S275","G339","R342","D366","G12","G201","D234"]
CHEM  =["K71","E175","T177"]                          # catalytic Lys / base, retained
R["subset"]=np.select([R.Hsc70.isin(KSHELL),R.Hsc70.isin(PHOS),R.Hsc70.isin(ADEN),R.Hsc70.isin(CHEM)],
                      ["K+ coordination shell","beta/gamma-phosphate region","adenosine/ribose + anchors","catalytic Lys/Glu"],default="other")
summ=R.groupby("subset").agg(n=("Hsc70","size"),Hsp110_mean=("Hsp110_pct","mean"),Hsp70_mean=("Hsp70_pct","mean")).round(1)
print(summ.to_string())

def agg(sub):
    s=R[R.subset==sub]
    return int(s.Hsp110_retained.sum()),int((s.Hsp110_n-s.Hsp110_retained).sum()),int(s.Hsp70_retained.sum()),int((s.Hsp70_n-s.Hsp70_retained).sum())
print("\nAggregate Fisher tests (Hsp110 vs Hsp70 retention of the Hsc70 residue):")
for sub in ["K+ coordination shell","beta/gamma-phosphate region","adenosine/ribose + anchors","catalytic Lys/Glu"]:
    a,b,c,d=agg(sub)
    orr,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
    print(f"  {sub:30s} Hsp110 {a}/{a+b} ({100*a/(a+b):.0f}%)  Hsp70 {c}/{c+d} ({100*c/(c+d):.0f}%)  OR={orr:.3g}  p={p:.3g}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.4))
order=["adenosine/ribose + anchors","catalytic Lys/Glu","beta/gamma-phosphate region","K+ coordination shell"]
sub=R[R.subset.isin(order)].copy()
sub["o"]=sub.subset.map({s:i for i,s in enumerate(order)})
sub=sub.sort_values(["o","Hsp110_pct"])
x=np.arange(len(sub))
ax.bar(x-0.2,sub.Hsp70_pct,0.4,color="#1f6f4a",label="40 nematode Hsp70s (control)")
ax.bar(x+0.2,sub.Hsp110_pct,0.4,color="#c0392b",label="49 nematode Hsp110s")
ax.set_xticks(x);ax.set_xticklabels(sub.Hsc70,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% of orthologs carrying the bovine Hsc70 residue");ax.set_ylim(0,112)
b=0
for s in order:
    k=(sub.subset==s).sum()
    ax.axvspan(b-0.5,b+k-0.5,color="#000000",alpha=0.03)
    ax.text(b+k/2-0.5,106,s,ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
    b+=k
    if b<len(sub): ax.axvline(b-0.5,color="grey",lw=.8)
ax.legend(loc="lower left",fontsize=9);ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("The loss is specific to the K+ cofactor shell and the beta/gamma-phosphate contacts\nNematode Hsp70s retain every one of these positions; nematode Hsp110s retain none of them",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.set_xlabel("Position in bovine Hsc70 (P19120 numbering)")
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
R.to_csv("hsp110_vs_hsp70_position_test.csv",index=False)
